THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
084
Behind the image
47 / Powder Fur
REFERENCE 5821.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 036
Art direction: Soft pastel blue and cream, low-rise silhouette, playful fur trim, muted vintage
interior.
Full-length vertical fashion editorial of an original adult East Asian woman with very long, straight
black hair parted in the center, soft blush and a calm, slightly tilted gaze, standing in a relaxed
contrapposto pose with one arm behind her. She wears a fitted powder-blue long-sleeve V-neck
cropped knit over a white collared shirt, low-rise wide-leg powder-blue trousers trimmed at the
waistband with fluffy beige faux fur, and gray-and-white retro sneakers. Pale textured plaster wall,
a vintage sage-green armchair at the edge of the frame, soft diffused daylight, muted pastel
palette, no text, watermark or logos.
48 / Varsity Scarf
REFERENCE 5820.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 037
Art direction: Academic heritage, navy, camel and mustard, retro schoolgirl styling with moto-boot
edge.
Full-length vertical fashion lookbook photograph of an original adult woman with long
copper-brown wavy hair in loose side braids, round thin-framed wire glasses and a calm, direct
gaze, standing with her hands clasped in front of her and a small black backpack at her shoulder.
She wears a fitted navy knit cardigan with mustard-yellow trim, a cream and brown striped silk
scarf tied in a large bow, a camel pleated mini skirt with a brown leather belt, cream slouchy knee
socks and tall dark brown leather boots with silver buckles. Cream plaster wall, herringbone wood
floor, soft warm studio light, vintage preppy mood, no text or logos.
